title: Path kernel K3: the load stage and the #4154 meter read differently on the stock edge line

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Found while working #4026 (K3, the load stage, on branch `issue/4026-kernel-load-control`).

What happens: the motion pin `kernel_laws::k3_load::kernel_load_control_round_the_disc_and_the_dog_bone` reads the kernel plan round the disc and the dog bone with the law measures of #4154 (60 degree limit, tool radius 4, step 2). On the Outside start, some feed moves read above the limit, and the load stage does not name a place within one tool radius of them:

| Case | None (no load control) | Constant engagement 25 % |
|---|---|---|
| disc Outside | 13 of 402 over moves | 74 of 334 over moves |
| dog bone Outside | 3 of 724 over moves | 66 of 678 over moves |

The Inside start has 0 (None) and 1 (constant engagement; a link feed, not a cut) unnamed moves.

The unnamed moves are on the stock edge line (`y = -25` or `x = -40`), at the ends of ring pieces that start after a lift. At those places the kernel read (`crates/pathkernel/src/load/law.rs`) gives ae/D 0.0 to 0.13. The meter of #4154 (`crates/motion/tests/common/law_measure/engage.rs`, rim of `mask_grid.rs::contact_width`) reads more than 62.5 degrees.

Expected: the two reads agree within the read tolerance, or the kernel read is the higher one. Then each move above the limit is named (law L6).

Possible causes to check: the raster cells on the stock boundary (`Region::contains` on the edge); the first read of a piece after an entry; the direction of the first feed of a piece.

Done means: the pin shows 0 unnamed moves on the Outside rows, or each one that stays has a named reason, and the cause is in the K3 decision file.
